name: B10-0573/2025 (ESN) – Grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text:
**What this asks for**

This text is an opinion, not a law. It comes from a small political group in the European Parliament and asks the European Union to change its approach to Guinea-Bissau after army generals stopped the presidential election results on 26 November 2025. It wants the European Union to talk to the new military authorities, tie development aid and trade to cooperation on taking back citizens who have no right to stay in Europe, and push the African Union to get involved.

**What concretely changes**

- Nothing changes yet. It is a request for the European Union to act, not a decision.
- If followed, aid and trade with Guinea-Bissau would depend on taking back its citizens.
- It also asks the African Union to step in and talk to the military authorities.
